title: Sticky rice ball (Tangyuan)
ingredients: Red bean paste or other fillings (purchased)
instructions: Prepare the rice dough with glutinous rice flour and water
Knead the dough to form a ball and let the ball rest for 20 minutes
Fill the rice balls with sweet fillings such as red bean paste or black sesame paste
Bring a large pot of water to boil, add the balls, stir
Once the rice balls float to the surface, they are cooked and ready to serve.
story: In China, we often eat Sticky rice ball (Tangyuan) to celebrate the Lantern Festival, which marks the end of the traditional Spring Festival celebrations. Making tangyuan is a fun family activity. People of all ages (from grandparents to young children) can gather together to make them. They can be served in a sweet syrup or with fermented sweet rice wine, which adds extra flavor.
